lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters distributed along the mid-lateral flank posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the circular blobs to form grid-like anchor nodes across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature along the upper third of the flank characterized by a sharp light-to-shadow vertical pixel gradient.
